jobs.name: alpha_dashboard
jobs.jobInput: Give me a market overview across Hyperliquid perpetuals with current bias and what to watch.
jobs.jobOutput:
TL;DR: Overall positioning is basically flat, so this doesn't look like a high-conviction, one-way market.

Bias: NEUTRAL (weak)

What's driving it
- Most signals are mixed (7 mixed), which usually means chop and lower conviction.
- Net exposure is close to flat (about -0.2K) and the 10-period average is flat too—no strong risk-on or risk-off tilt.
- Volatility backdrop is still lively: realized vol (BTC ~75, ETH ~101) is running above implied (BTC 0.65x, ETH 0.74x), which often goes with bigger swings than options are pricing.
- Despite the mixed tape, there's concentrated strength: ADA and POL are flagged "long-only" with very high scores, and ARB/TIA are also "long-only."
- On the bearish side, RESOLV is the one clear "short-only" outlier.

What to watch / what changes the bias
- If more names flip from mixed into "long-only," bias could move from weak neutral toward constructive; if the longs fade and more "short-only" prints appear, bias shifts bearish.
- Watch whether net exposure meaningfully moves away from flat (either direction). A sustained build in net long/short would raise conviction.
- Track whether the bullish leaders (ADA, POL, ARB, TIA) keep leading—broad follow-through would be a healthier tape than isolated pockets.
- Keep an eye on RESOLV: if that "short-only" weakness spreads to other names, it's a warning sign for the broader market.

Top bullish tickers
- ADA, POL, ARB, TIA

Top bearish tickers
- RESOLV
